text:
**Current inventory — 21 variants**
Core: unanswered, list end, selected, correct, incorrect, question loading, empty questions, load failure, submitting, submission failure, middle/last page, long content.
Studies: expanded/collapsed narrow workspace, hover, keyboard focus, empty sidebar, phone, sidebar loading/failure.
Ghost trigger available in every variant; hidden at collapsed pointer rest and revealed on hover/focus. External component specimens distinguish default, hover, pressed and single-outline focus; collapsed hover and keyboard focus are separate. The three latest studies and empty sidebar remain proposals. Native visual review pending.
